name: MA-9 Frontline Droid
description: The MA-9 Frontline Droid was a model of bipedal battle droid available during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The MA-9 was marketed as being obedient, adaptive, and deadly, and was equipped with a jet charge and a blade built into its bracer, as well as an optional carbonizing spray. The Twi'lek arms dealer Olok the Shadow sold MA-9 Frontline Droids in his auction on Darvannis.
